relations.justification: Traditional preservation techniques are the pre-refrigeration food technology the survival domain teaches as method.
Oral-formulaic composition and universal coding are both strategies for transmitting more than the channel would otherwise carry — formula is a shared codebook.
Traditional board games are the empirical corpus that early game theory abstracted from.
Recording a craft process requires the interview method oral history developed, because the knowledge is tacit and the maker cannot simply state it.
Traditional craft technique is the historically transmitted case of the craft practices Arts describes.
Oral history method derives from ethnographic interviewing and shares its reflexive problem.
